title: Backup Delivery Plane for Offline Asset Access
acceptanceCriteria: Tablet can download asset bundle when Seneca server is completely unavailable
Download requires valid Kinde JWT - unauthenticated requests return 401
Tenant A cannot access Tenant B bundles (cross-tenant isolation verified)
Bundle sha256 integrity is verified before decryption on device
Cached bundle is used as fallback when both Seneca and AWS are unreachable
Bundle versions are never overwritten - rollback possible to any previous version
No AWS credentials are present in the tablet app or frontend code
S3 bucket has no public access (Block Public Access enabled)
Bundles are encrypted at rest (KMS) and in transit (HTTPS)
Bundle Builder Lambda produces a valid bundle for each active tenant at least every 60 minutes
latest.json pointer is atomically updated only after successful bundle upload and validation
Cached bundles on device are encrypted at rest (IndexedDB with encryption layer)
Cached bundles expire after validUntil timestamp and show degraded-mode warning to users
Frontend BackupService does not consume connection pool slots (DEC-000015)
CloudFormation Backup Stack deploys independently from VPC and Application stacks
Monitoring and alerting configured for bundle generation failures and signer errors

objects.latest.json: Pointer to current bundle (bundleId, sha256, sequenceNum, validUntil)
objects.manifests/manifest-v{seq}.json: Bundle manifest with entity counts, timestamps, integrity

s3_layout.lifecycle: Expire bundles older than 90 days, transition to Glacier after 30 days

signer_lambda.auth: Kinde JWT via API Gateway Lambda Authorizer

process: 1. List active tenants from config (DynamoDB or S3 allowlist)
2. For each tenant: read all pqs/asset, pqs/sap, pqs/group entities from DynamoDB
4. Encrypt with KMS envelope encryption (per-tenant CMK)
5. Upload to S3 with versioned key

verification: Validate JWT signature against Kinde JWKS endpoint (cached)
Verify audience matches expected client ID
Extract org_code/org_id claim for tenant scoping
Return IAM policy allowing invoke on matched tenantId path only

frontend_backup_service.health_check: Detect Seneca unavailability via failed API calls or explicit health endpoint
frontend_backup_service.download: Fetch presigned URL from signer, download bundle, verify sha256
frontend_backup_service.decryption: Decrypt bundle using Web Crypto API with key from signer response
frontend_backup_service.caching: Store in IndexedDB via Dexie.js, encrypted at rest
frontend_backup_service.fallback: On total connectivity loss, serve last-known-good cached bundle
frontend_backup_service.cache_validity: Respect validUntil field; warn users when serving expired cache
frontend_backup_service.connection_pool: Use standalone fetch(), NOT the Seneca connection pool (DEC-000015)

infrastructure.stack: Separate CloudFormation 'Backup Stack' (independent from VPC and Application stacks)
resources: CloudWatch alarms (builder failures, signer errors, latency)

error_responses.403: User not authorized for this tenant

data_flow.bundle_generation: EventBridge → Builder Lambda → DynamoDB (read) → ZIP + Encrypt → S3 (write) → latest.json (update)
data_flow.bundle_delivery: Tablet App → Kinde JWT → API Gateway → JWT Authorizer → Signer Lambda → S3 presigned URL → Tablet downloads → Verify → Decrypt → IndexedDB cache
data_flow.offline_fallback: Tablet App → Check signer endpoint → Fail → Load from IndexedDB cache → Check validUntil → Serve (with warning if expired)

deliverables: CloudFormation Backup Stack template (S3, KMS, Lambdas, API Gateway, EventBridge)
Integration test suite (auth flow, download, cross-tenant, offline fallback)
Operations runbook (key rotation, monitoring, incident response)

timeline.week_1: Infrastructure: S3 bucket, KMS keys, IAM roles, JWT Authorizer Lambda
timeline.week_2: Signer Lambda + API Gateway endpoint, basic end-to-end auth flow
timeline.week_3: Bundle Builder Lambda, EventBridge cron, DynamoDB read + package + encrypt + upload
timeline.week_4: Frontend BackupService, health detection, download + verify + decrypt
timeline.week_5: IndexedDB caching layer, offline fallback, cache validity, degraded-mode UI
timeline.week_6: CloudFormation stack, integration testing, cross-tenant isolation tests
timeline.week_7: Hardening, monitoring, alerting, ops runbook, documentation
timeline.risk_buffer: 1 week for KMS multi-tenant complexity and tablet IndexedDB edge cases

success_metrics.availability: Backup data accessible within 30s when Seneca is down
success_metrics.freshness: Bundle no more than 60 minutes stale
success_metrics.security: Zero cross-tenant access in penetration testing
